summary: Dobermanns are intelligent dogs and a breed that is known the world over for its keen senses and alert natures. However although they are often used as watch dogs in many parts of the world they are highly adaptable and fit in well with family life enjoying nothing more than being involved in everything that goes on around them. Dobermanns are proud they are calm and when responsibly bred and correctly handled they become valued members of a family.
